picked_topic.title: Microsoft launches "Copilot Cowork," an AI built to do work, not just chat
picked_topic.why: It's the clearest sign yet that workplace AI is shifting from answering questions to handling entire tasks end-to-end — and it reportedly has Claude reviewing GPT's drafts inside the same tool.

script:
Microsoft just turned Copilot into a coworker — literally. Copilot Cowork is now live worldwide for every Microsoft 365 Copilot user, built on Anthropic's Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 4.6, with GPT-5.5 available through Frontier. Tell it what you need — say, a market research memo — and it plans the work itself: pulling data, writing the summary, and building the spreadsheet across Outlook, Teams, and Excel, with no back-and-forth chat required. Microsoft's charging usage-based, by model calls and runtime, and a cheaper in-house model called Cowork 1 is reportedly coming soon. This is the clearest sign yet that workplace AI is moving from answering questions to just finishing the job.

I'm Nova. Stay ahead — for more AI news, subscribe to the link in the bio.
